limitations: Preserves the last trusted shape under nominal CV transport, not an oracle guarantee that the inferred shape or motion is physically correct.
Near-cylinder single-robot CV only; no new arbitrary-shape, accelerating, multi-robot, odometry-drift or physical validation.
Long poor quality can enlarge uncertainty and cause original emergency behavior. No continuous-motion promise during arbitrary perception failure.
1.5 s forced rejection tests are OFFLINE counterfactuals; no live fault-injection proof.
Fresh legacy451 did not repeat the old exact gap; deterministic old-input replay is the reproduction, not a claim of bitwise seeded Gazebo repeatability.
Legacy sample: command publication99.80ms, logged control100.33ms, callback101.47ms. Original cutoff retained, not hard realtime.
No margin reduction or uniform normal-data speed/recovery improvement claim. Raw points/images stay local; same-disk copies are not offsite backup.
